result.summary: Refactors transaction construction in fee estimator unit tests to initialize inputs and outputs directly with constructor calls and initializer lists instead of resizing vectors and assigning fields post-allocation. In blockpolicyestimator_tests, deduplicates repeated transaction submission and mempool entry creation logic into an add_tx helper lambda.
result.problem: Fee estimator unit tests construct test transactions imperatively by mutating templates and resizing vectors, while blockpolicyestimator_tests repeats identical transaction submission boilerplate across three separate test loops.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data')
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach or diff; likely a rebase.
result.card: This PR refactors unit test transaction setup in blockpolicyestimator_tests and mempool_fee_estimator_tests to use direct constructor calls and initializer lists rather than mutating templates and resizing vectors. It also extracts repeated fee estimator submission boilerplate into an add_tx helper lambda. The change is part of tracking issue #36692 for declarative test data construction, with no behavior change.

risk.why: Only touches fee estimator unit tests; a bug would only cause unit test failures.
